en-US.author: axes4 GmbH
en-US.copyright: Copyright © 2026 axes4 GmbH. All rights reserved.
en-US.description: Test and correct PDF documents for accessibility.
en-US.longDescription: axesPDF checks PDF documents against PDF/UA and WCAG accessibility requirements and includes tools for correcting problems.
en-US.name: axesPDF
en-US.releaseNotes:
Improvements
- Improved performance: In our tests, the PDF/UA, WCAG and Quality checks ran about 75% faster.
- Reduced memory consumption: In our tests, the PDF/UA, WCAG and Quality checks used about 60% less memory.
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where axesPDF showed an incorrect warning for form annotations inside paragraph-like structure elements.
- A bug with Entra ID licensing has been fixed.
